title: Transfer: Topology Data Quality Audit
goal: Given a MATPOWER network snapshot, generate `topology_audit.json` identifying orphan buses, duplicate corridors, zero-reactance or zero-rating anomalies, invalid generator-to-bus references, and a normalized bus-index map for downstream tooling.
skillBenefitRationale: This is a pure network-data QA task that requires detailed handling of MATPOWER field layouts, bus numbering conventions, and branch connectivity, with no dependence on any non-shipped skill.
